plan.rule: Preserve original EMA(hl2) centre, EMA(high-low) width, close crossing, anti-chase, opposite exit, initial stop and percentage profit protection. Only replace candle timeframe; periods remain counts of bars, not constant clock duration. No new momentum, moving-average crossover or Donchian rules.
plan.selection: Per coin, before viewing new timeframe results: original ETH6-year winner as control, top2 unique parameter sets by already-observed original15m full-history return pooled across prior alt/repair studies, and best original15m last2year parameter set. Exactly4 per coin; no expansion, no parameter retuning on new timeframe outcomes.
